title: User input to enhance synthetic data generation

title: How we engineered constraint handling strategies in SDV

title: Building the Unique Combinations Constraint in the SDV

title: Improving synthetic data up to +40% without building new ML models

title: Train an SDV Generative AI: A random subsample is all you need
